select Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='AUD'
UNION ALL
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='BBC'
UNION ALL
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='CAD'
UNION ALL
SELECT Main_Sales_Channel Main_Sales_Channel2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_CHANNELCODE WHERE Main_Sales_Channel='999' ) temp order by Main_Sales_Channel, SCD_START_DATE
